newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 28.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Truck drivers' unions call for strike extension for higher wages after winning agreement with employers on earlier retirement.

-- Bank of France Monetary Policy Council member Jean-Pierre Gerard says in an interview that while the current franc-mark rate poses no problems, a change in the parity may be necessary, adds correct level of dollar should be six francs, also calls for a stronger dollar against the mark.
-- European micro-electronics industries, notably Philips, Siemens and SGS-Thomson, to renew industrial co-operation agreements, share research and development costs for microchips.
-- LVMH luxury goods group buys prestigious Chateau d'Yquem vineyard.
-- Government reaffirms conditions for planned merger between Framatome and Anglo-French venture GEC-Alsthom, including need for French control of the new unit.
-- New GAN chairman Didier Pfeiffer to be confirmed in his functions at December 4 cabinet meeting. He is expected to name Philippe Pontet to head CIC unit.
